messages.author: d192bffdecbad89c
messages.subject: stan discussions on gmane
parts:
Hi All,

I am an emacs/gnus user, and very fond of gmane for reading mailing lists.  Would it be possible to have stan's Google mailing lists carried by gmane?

I would put it in myself, though I have heard that it is better if the lists' administrators do the requesting, so they would not be surprised to receive an email approving the mirror.

Thanks,
Eric

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] stan discussions on gmane
parts:
I personally don't like mirroring of mailing list content
because it just frustrates me finding the same thing with
different snippets in Google searches.

- Bob
